records.title: Optimal Scheduling Algorithms for LLM Inference: Theory and Practice
records.reason: Develops a theoretical framework for routing and scheduling in two-phase (prefill/decode) LLM inference and proposes the throughput-optimal Resource-Aware Dynamic scheduler plus the SLO-aware SLAI scheduler for time-between-token constraints.

records.title: T WIN KV: A C OMPOSABLE R EPAIR P ASS FOR KV C ACHE E VICTION VIA P AIRWISE K EY R EDUNDANCY
records.reason: TwinKV is a training-free KV cache eviction repair pass that discounts value energy by nonlocal post-RoPE key frequency, beating five compressed baselines on LongBench, LooGLE and RULER at 50-75% KV removal under an exact storage budget.

records.title: ShamAN-Q: Shampoo Augmented NanoQuant for Sub-1-bit LLM Weights
records.reason: ShamAN-Q is a sub-1-bit post-training quantization method that replaces NanoQuant diagonal reconstruction geometry with a Shampoo-style Kronecker-factored Fisher Mahalanobis loss, lowering Qwen3 perplexity at about 1 bit per weight.

records.title: PS-SA: An Efficient Self-Attention via Progressive Sampling for User Behavior Sequence Modeling
records.reason: PS-SA progressively samples valuable item pairs to make self-attention efficient for user behavior sequence modeling in recommender systems; a recommender-systems application of sparse attention.

records.title: TagRouter: Learning Route to LLMs through Tags for Open-Domain Text Generation Tasks
records.reason: TagRouter is a training-free tag-based routing method that allocates queries across multiple LLMs, raising system accept rate by 6.15% while reducing serving cost by 17.20% versus 13 baselines.

records.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Shared Memory in Looped Transformers
records.reason: Looped Prediction Transformers pretrain looped LMs so only the first recursion writes a KV cache and later recursions read the shared cache plus a short local window, cutting context memory 76-79% at better perplexity.

records.title: SAID: Accelerating Diffusion-Based Language Models via Scaffold-Aware Iterative Decoding
records.reason: SAID reallocates denoising computation across scaffold and detail tokens (plus confidence-hierarchical layered generation) to accelerate diffusion LLM inference up to 9.1x on LLaDA models.

records.title: FoveaTree: Information-Density Trees for Query-Guided Visual Token Pruning in Video Large Language Models
records.reason: FoveaTree is a two-stage training-free visual token pruning framework (merge-gain density quadtree plus attention tree pruning) that reduces the hundreds of per-frame visual tokens driving Video LLM inference cost.

records.title: CIMERA: Compute-in-Interconnect and Memory with Reconfigurable Precision for LLM Inference
records.reason: CIMERA is a reconfigurable-precision LLM inference accelerator integrating compute-in-interconnect and memory to mitigate the memory wall, reporting up to 25x and 10x higher energy efficiency than an H100 for 1B and 13B models.

records.title: Armour: Generalizable Compact Self-Attention for Vision Transformers
records.reason: Armour is a compact, generalizable self-attention mechanism producing smaller and faster vision transformers; an efficient-attention contribution for ViTs rather than LLM inference.

records.title: Routing, Cascades, and User Choice for LLMs
records.reason: Models LLM routing and cascading as a Stackelberg game with a re-prompting user and characterizes provider-optimal versus user-preferred routes; routing policy theory without a serving system implementation.

records.title: ChromFound: Towards A Universal Foundation Model for Single-Cell Chromatin Accessibility Data
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a foundation model for single-cell chromatin accessibility data, a genomics application domain.

records.title: Late-Layer Fusion is Enough: Dual-Path Vision Token Routing for Multimodal Large Language Models under Visual Saturation
records.reason: Dual-Path Vision Token Routing exploits the finding that vision tokens saturate by layer 4 in LLaVA-1.5, routing them through a late-layer-fusion path to remove redundant visual computation in MLLM inference.

records.title: A Novel Shortcut between Local Windows for Window-based Vision Transformers
records.reason: Adds a local-window shortcut with spatial/channel transformations to window-based vision transformers, evaluated on CIFAR100/Tiny-ImageNet classification; a CV architecture tweak.

records.title: GDeR: Safeguarding Efficiency, Balancing, and Robustness via Prototypical Graph Pruning
records.reason: GDeR prunes training data for graph neural networks using prototypical graphs to preserve balance and robustness; training-data curation for GNNs.

records.title: Unifying Convolution and Attention via Convolutional Nearest Neighbors
records.reason: ConvNN unifies convolution and self-attention as k-nearest-neighbor aggregation and validates hybrid layers on ImageNet classification; a computer-vision framework.

records.title: When Is 0.1% Enough? Analyzing the Combined Effects of Dimensionality Reduction and Quantization on Text Embedding Compression
records.reason: Systematically analyzes combined dimensionality reduction and quantization of text embeddings on MTEB, showing near-original scores at under 0.1% storage for classification; an embedding-compression study centered on storage rather than LLM inference execution.

records.title: NeuralZip: Reusable Setup for Fast Lossless Compression
records.reason: NeuralZip losslessly compresses model weight checkpoints by grouping exponent distributions and sharing Huffman codes, making post-setup encoding 1.81-21.33x faster with exact reconstruction; it reduces weight storage/transfer, not inference computation.

records.title: Spatial-Mamba: Effective Visual State Space Models via Structure-Aware State Fusion
records.reason: Spatial-Mamba adds structure-aware state fusion with dilated convolutions so Mamba-style SSMs capture 2D image structure; a vision architecture.

records.title: GCformer: An Efficient Solution for Accurate and Scalable Long-Term Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: GCformer combines a sublinear-complexity global convolution branch with a local transformer branch for long-term multivariate time series forecasting benchmarks; a forecasting task model.

records.title: EllieSQL: Cost-Efficient Text-to-SQL with Complexity-Aware Routing
records.reason: EllieSQL routes text-to-SQL queries to generation pipelines of differing cost by estimated complexity, introducing a Token Elasticity of Performance metric; cost-aware routing bound to a single application pipeline.

records.title: HGMamba: Enhancing 3D Human Pose Estimation with a HyperGCN-Mamba Network
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a HyperGCN-Mamba network for 3D human pose estimation, a computer-vision application task.

records.title: Query-adaptive Recurrent Tokenization
records.reason: QART is a query-adaptive recurrent tokenizer that allocates visual tokens until query-relevant features are faithfully represented, cutting visual token counts 20-25x versus dense VLM inputs on Visual7W/VQAv2.

records.title: Efficient Deployment of Very Wide and Very Deep Hypersparse FFNs on FPGA
records.reason: Proposes compressing data structures and quantizing parameters so very wide/deep hypersparse FFNs fit entirely on FPGA fabric, eliminating off-chip DRAM accesses during the inference forward pass.

records.title: Hybrid Speculative Decoding in RAG: When Do the Pros Outweigh the Cons?
records.reason: Analyzes when hybrid speculative decoding helps RAG workloads and contributes a prefix-tree variable-length n-gram matching implementation 1.4x faster than reported alternatives; primarily a diagnostic study of an existing SD variant.

records.title: Splitwise: Efficient Generative LLM Inference Using Phase Splitting
records.reason: Splitwise splits the compute-intensive prefill and memory-intensive decode phases of generative LLM inference onto different machines with efficient request-state transfer, achieving up to 2.35x throughput within the same power and cost budgets.

records.title: StreamDCIM: A Tile-based Streaming Digital CIM Accelerator with Mixed-stationary Cross-forwarding Dataflow for Multimodal Transformer
records.reason: StreamDCIM is a tile-based streaming digital compute-in-memory accelerator with reconfigurable macros and a mixed-stationary cross-forwarding dataflow designed to accelerate multimodal transformer inference.

records.title: Extending Input Contexts of Language Models through Training on Segmented Sequences
records.reason: Trains language models on sub-sampled segmented sequences with positional interpolation to extend usable context 4x; a context-extension training procedure.

records.title: Block-wise Bit-Compression of Transformer-based Models
records.reason: BBCT performs block-wise bit-compression of an entire transformer (embeddings, matrix multiplications, GELU, softmax, layer normalization and intermediates) without retraining, targeting the memory footprint and latency of cloud inference.

records.title: g-BERT: Enabling Green BERT Deployment on FPGA via Hardware-Aware Hybrid Pruning
records.reason: g-BERT prunes BERT with hardware-aware HLS latency/power metrics and hybrid head/layer patterns for green deployment on FPGAs; an encoder-era deployment study rather than modern LLM inference.

records.title: Efficient Visual Tracking with Exemplar Transformers
records.reason: Exemplar Transformers use a single instance-level attention layer for real-time visual object tracking at 47 FPS on CPU across LaSOT/OTB/TrackingNet; a visual tracking task model.

records.title: Deformable Mesh Transformer for 3D Human Mesh Recovery
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a deformable mesh transformer for 3D human mesh recovery, a computer-vision application task.

records.title: Quantformer: Learning Extremely Low-Precision Vision Transformers
records.reason: Quantformer quantizes vision transformers to extremely low precision with self-attention rank consistency and group-wise patch discretization for efficient inference; vision-model quantization rather than LLM inference.

records.title: Distilling Large Language Models into Tiny and Effective Students using pQRNN
records.reason: pQRNN is a tiny projection-based student encoder distilled from large multilingual LMs, reaching 95.9% of mBERT performance at 350x smaller size for latency-critical NLP; encoder-era model compression.

records.title: Transformers for End-to-End InfoSec Tasks: A Feasibility Study
records.reason: Feasibility study of end-to-end transformer detectors for malicious URLs and PE files with mixed-objective training; an information-security classification application.

records.title: A Review on Hybrid Cryptographic and Deep Learning Approach for Secure File Transmission
records.reason: Title explicitly reviews hybrid cryptographic and deep learning approaches for secure file transmission, a security application review.

records.title: Multi-LLM Query Optimization
records.reason: Formulates robust offline query allocation across heterogeneous LLMs minimizing cost under per-label error constraints, proving NP-hardness and a feasibility-preserving surrogate; cost-optimization theory for ensemble classification rather than a serving system.

records.title: CatchUp: Depth-Aware Re-Admission of Visual Tokens for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models
records.reason: CatchUp combines reversible visual-token routing with local transition correction that refreshes stale re-admitted hidden states, sustaining LVLM accuracy at a fixed 64-visual-token budget across decoder depth.

records.title: Change Detection Needs Neighborhood Interaction in Transformer
records.reason: Title explicitly addresses change detection, the remote-sensing image analysis task, with neighborhood interaction in transformers; a remote-sensing application.

records.title: A deep language model to predict metabolic network equilibria
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a deep language model to predict metabolic network equilibria, a systems-biology application.

records.title: GSIFN: A Graph-Structured and Interlaced-Masked Multimodal Transformer Based Fusion Network for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
records.reason: GSIFN is a graph-structured interlaced-masked transformer fusion network for multimodal sentiment analysis with a self-supervised LSTM feature framework; a sentiment-analysis task model.

records.title: InAttention: Linear Context Scaling for Transformers
records.reason: InAttention replaces decoder self-attention so tokens attend only to initial states, making VRAM scale linearly with context length during inference and enabling long sequences on consumer GPUs.

records.title: Efficient Self-supervised Vision Pretraining with Local Masked Reconstruction
records.reason: LoMaR performs masked reconstruction inside 7x7 local windows to cut the cost of self-supervised vision pretraining (MAE/BEiT-style); a pretraining-efficiency method for vision.

records.title: MODA: MOdular Duplex Attention for Multimodal Perception, Cognition, and Emotion Understanding
records.reason: MODA is a modular duplex attention mechanism addressing cross-modal attention inconsistency in MLLMs for perception, cognition and emotion understanding; a capability architecture, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Beyond 4 bits: Data-Centric Post-training Quantization and Recovery
records.reason: Systematic study of 2-bit post-training quantization and recovery fine-tuning across model families that distills a practical recipe (vector codebook representation, task-aligned calibration mixture, codebook-only distillation) for accurate sub-4-bit LLM deployment.

records.title: LTSMiTransformer: Learnable Temporal Sparsity and Memory for Efficient Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: LTSMiTransformer integrates learnable temporal sparse attention and a memory module for long-term time series forecasting accuracy; a forecasting task architecture.

records.title: Distributed Dynamic Associative Memory via Online Convex Optimization
records.reason: Introduces distributed dynamic associative memory and a tree-based distributed online gradient descent algorithm with static/dynamic regret bounds; online-learning theory.

records.title: A Second-Order Perspective on Pruning at Initialization and Knowledge Transfer
records.reason: Second-order investigation of why pruning pre-trained vision models at initialization on one task preserves zero-shot transfer to unseen tasks; an empirical/theoretical pruning study.

records.title: BudgetMLAgent: A Cost-Effective LLM Multi-Agent system for Automating Machine Learning Tasks
records.reason: BudgetMLAgent combines profiling, retrieval of past observations, LLM cascades and ask-the-expert calls to cut the cost of automating ML engineering tasks by 94.2%; an application-level agent cost optimization, not an inference system.

records.title: The DEformer: An Order-Agnostic Distribution Estimating Transformer
records.reason: The DEformer encodes feature identity alongside values so sequential transformers can do order-agnostic density estimation, demonstrated on binarized MNIST; a generative-modeling proof of concept.
